title: Practice 11: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **пройти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
exercises.prompt: How do I get to the beach?

exercises.q: Он ___ (пройти, pf., past m. sg.) через толпу.
exercises.why: **прошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Боли в желудке ___ (пройти, pf., past pl.).
exercises.why: **прошли** — past tense (plural) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
